entries.en: To sift rice; to clean rice with a sieve.
To sift rice (variant entry of the preceding).
entries.notes: L 栏与上条全同；H 栏「笞」本义为笞打，与筛米不合，当是同词异写或借字，义仍取筛米。

entries.zh: 契子；干儿子，受洗教子（天主教语境）。
entries.en: Godson; adopted son, child taken as kin by contract.
To be satiated; to have eaten one's fill.
To be bloated with food; to be surfeited.
To drown; to sink and perish in water.
To perish by drowning; to be lost beneath the water.

entries.zh: 捂住口鼻使人窒息；闷绝。
entries.en: To smother; to choke a person by stopping the breath.

entries.zh: 捂住口鼻使人透不过气。
entries.en: To smother by covering the mouth.
entries.notes: H 栏作「翕口」，而 M 栏 chúi 对应「水」、R 栏 quîng quièn 亦与「翕口」常读不合，第二字存疑，义据 L 栏。

entries.en: To smother someone to death; to suffocate.

entries.zh: 淹没；以水没顶使人窒息。
entries.en: To drown by cutting off the breath; to submerge.

entries.zh: 溺死；淹死（字形与对音不合，义从西语词头）。
entries.en: To drown (gloss inferred from the Spanish headword only).
entries.notes: H 栏「澂」义为水清、R 栏 quī 亦非「溺」之常读，M 栏 quiêc 入声字无相应溺死义，四栏不能互证，仅据 L 栏 ahogarse 推定。

entries.zh: 闷死；窒息致死（西语并列 anegarse，义近淹溺）。
entries.en: To be smothered to death; to suffocate (glossed with anegarse, to be inundated).
entries.notes: H 栏「慍」本义为怒，与闷窒不合，M 栏 ùn 与「悶」音近，疑借作闷窒之字，义据 L 栏 ahogarse/anegarse 定。

entries.en: To hang (a person); to execute by hanging.
To hang oneself; to strangle oneself.
